body.p: (task 0.6). The allocator test double, sxml_counting_allocator, is in memory.h and the library, not in tests/, so embedders can drive the failure paths of their own code. It wraps a backing allocator, counts attempts, failures, releases, live allocations and bytes, and fails exactly the allocation numbered failing_allocation_number (from 1; 0 = none). Test pattern for every module (see test_arena_survives_every_allocation_failure in tests/memory_test.c): run the operation with failing number 1, 2, 3, ... until it succeeds; after each run live_allocation_count must be 0.
